stateDefinition.units: dimensionless; not volts and not final luminance
stateDefinition.endpointPolicy: state==target is exact; residual below 1/65536 snaps exactly to the target
stateDefinition.colorBoundary: evaluate exact settled coordinates through the unchanged WS1 32-cubed D65 LUT

responseDefinition.sourceDefinition: Sharp Table 2 labels only 'on and off' and 'gray scales'; no threshold, direction, gray pair, temperature, or waveform is supplied.
responseDefinition.fullScaleReference: code 0 to 31 and 31 to 0 use the on-and-off anchor symmetrically
responseDefinition.grayReference: adjacent middle transitions 15 to 16 and 16 to 15 use the gray-scales anchor symmetrically

rateEquation.identityCell: uses grayMs as a replaceable table value; the exact state==target fixed point bypasses rate evaluation

selectedModel.modelSelectionReason: Smallest causal model that matches all accepted scalar compatibility anchors; table rates remain replaceable by future measurements.

members.familyInterpretation: HCR-like endpoint; does not assert that the CGB is HCR
members.uncertainty: Source response definition and relationship to CGB are unknown.

members.familyInterpretation: arithmetic midpoint between the HCR-like and GH-like family bounds; not a measured typical CGB
members.uncertainty: Chosen only as a neutral period midpoint until CGB-specific data exists.

members.familyInterpretation: GH-like endpoint; does not assert that the CGB is GH
members.uncertainty: Source response definition and relationship to CGB are unknown.

uncertaintyDimensions.waveform: Sharp family source has no waveform; first-order is the minimum selected shape

specimenOverrideContract.replacementRule: A valid measured cell replaces only the addressed rate and provenance; invalid or absent cells retain the reconstructed rate.
